title: Build the Olympus spec layer in docs/spec.toml with a checking test
summary: Retry: build docs/spec.toml, the cohesive requirements layer from the Project Olympus part of BRIEF.md and the 2026-10-17 addenda, with verbatim cited sources and open questions, plus an xtask test that checks it. The audience is the agents that will read the spec and Sri, who approves it. The reading is unchanged from the accepted one.

defaults_applied.how: xtask test with negative cases; cargo test and clippy clean.
Tests check quotes, counts and negative cases, not just file existence.
Use a maintained toml crate for parsing rather than hand-rolling.
Spec and decision record written for outside readers.
No owner-side or personal data in the spec.
Only the Olympus layer; no reader or prompt changes.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Retry of rejected job 20261017-205600-a37m with the same scope; the earlier accepted reading stands.
Audience: agents that will read the spec, and Sri who approves it.

The earlier rejection reason is unrecorded; likely causes are quote mismatches against BRIEF.md, incomplete coverage, or a policy.rs leak, so the producer should verify each quote and run the whole workspace tests.
The checker lives in xtask/tests/spec.rs and may need a toml dependency (buy-first) in xtask/Cargo.toml.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test parses docs/spec.toml and passes; in-memory negative cases each fail the checker for (a) a quote not a verbatim substring of BRIEF.md after collapsing whitespace, (b) a duplicate id, (c) a supersedes target that does not exist, (d) a requirement with no source.

Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test counts requirements by their sources' headings and finds at least one for each of R1–R8, Phases 1–6 with their acceptance, section 10 (Final system acceptance), and 2026-10-17 decisions 3C, 4A, 5A and 7A.

Each requirement in docs/spec.toml has an id, a plain statement, a kind (goal, requirement, constraint, acceptance), a status (active or superseded), and one or more sources (verbatim quote plus heading). Duplicates across sections are merged into one requirement with several sources. Requirement-bearing sentences in Olympus sections 1–10, the governing philosophy and the 2026-10-17 addenda are covered.
docs/spec.toml records at least one open question with both verbatim quotes where Sri's words conflict or leave a choice open; it is recorded, not resolved.
docs/spec.toml has no statement about who runs Athena or where; `cargo test -p xtask` shows xtask/tests/policy.rs still passes.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo test`: all clean and passing.

CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the spec; docs/decisions.md records the spec format and the choice of TOML with alternatives (Markdown with ids, JSON, YAML). No earlier Athena brief parts are specified; no reader or prompt is changed.

out_of_scope: The Athena brief's earlier parts (a later layer)
Changing any reader or prompt to use the spec
Owner/operator-side statements about who runs Athena or where
departures: Large spec file with many verbatim quotes raises the chance of failure, so cost is somewhat above the reference and verification probability slightly below.
